name: Bitbucket
why: Bitbucket seems like it’s been neglected the exact right amount for it to be a pretty decent choice.

quotes.quote: Bitbucket seems like it’s been neglected the exact right amount for it to be a pretty decent choice.
quotes.excerpt: It’s interesting how under the radar Bitbucket is these days. I use it at work alongside GitHub (patchwork of merged companies). There are random little things I like about it better than GitHub, especially in an enterprise setting. And it has never gone down in my entire tenure at this company, while GitHub is like a weekly outage nightmare these days. Atlassian is doing a whole lot of strange and desperate stuff la

Bitbucket was the perfect alternative. I used it back in the day when they were the only ones who offered free private repos. Ahead of their time. GH beat them on UI/UX and the PR workflow I think. Really nothing more than having a better ~$120k Product Designer working there. Kinda funny what actually makes people stick with 1 choice over another.
